dataset_name: LocalExploreAI Ranker & Flood Risk Training Dataset

pii_compliance.details: All user identifiers are pseudonymized (user_key, session_key, reviewer_key). No names, phone numbers, email addresses, or physical home addresses are included.

ranker.purpose: Rank points of interest (POI) and local experiences tailored to user context and intent.
ranker.row_unit: One row per displayed item within a recommendation request list

flood_risk.purpose: Predict future flood occurrence within a specified target window given antecedent features cut off before the event.
flood_risk.row_unit: One row per location_key and time window (feature_cutoff_utc to target_end_utc)
flood_risk.split_strategy: GroupKFold by group_id and temporal split to eliminate spatial-temporal leakage.
